lines.zh: 我拖着半截身体爬过来。
lines.en: I drag half a body along the floor.

lines.zh: 我的零件在地上刮出响声。
lines.en: My parts scrape the floor.

lines.zh: 我的头歪着，挂在一根电缆上。
lines.en: My head hangs askew on a cable.
I pull myself forward on my elbows.

lines.zh: 我的腿在身后拖着，不管用。
lines.en: My legs drag behind, useless.

lines.zh: 我每一步都掉下一点东西。
lines.en: I drop a little something with every step.

lines.zh: 我爬到墙边，又拐了个弯。
lines.en: I reach the wall and turn.

lines.zh: 我的壳裂着，露出里面的线。
lines.en: My shell is split, wires showing.
I shift along the corridor.
My shadow is a tangle.
I am not fast, but I never stop.
I creep forward another tile.
I lie on the floor while my head turns.

lines.zh: 一根线从我身上垂下来。
lines.en: A wire dangles off me.
My folded leg jerks once.
I am piecing myself together.
I hear steps upstairs.
I have never stood straight.
My eyes are mismatched.

lines.zh: 我停在那里，像一堆零件。
lines.en: I stop there like a heap of parts.
I turn myself half a circle.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，脖子发出响声。
lines.en: I lift my head and my neck crackles.
You see what I have become.
Bent like this, and still moving.
Do not stare at my cracks.

lines.zh: 我的头歪着，是因为坏了。
lines.en: My head is crooked because I am broken.
I prop myself up to look at you.
You stand so tall.
I am used to seeing people this way.
My hand can reach you.
We are not far apart.
My wires are exposed.
I make a high, thin sound.
My head rolls a short way.
I drag it back.
I scrape along the floor.

lines.zh: 零件叮叮当当落了一地。
lines.en: Parts clatter to the floor.
I am still moving.
You still will not stop.
My jaw is crooked.
I can reach it, but I do not want it.
Who are you holding it up for?
I look and turn away.
My hands are all wires; I cannot grip.

lines.zh: 你把东西留下了，我收下。
lines.en: You left something behind. I'll take it.

lines.zh: 你手里那块电路板，看着眼熟。
lines.en: That circuit board in your hand looks familiar.

lines.zh: 零件凑一凑，也许能拼回原样。
lines.en: Enough spare parts, and maybe I can be whole again.
You trip over my leg.
The bump scatters me.
I put myself back together.
My parts roll to your feet.
The blow knocks my head off.
I reach for the wall and miss.
There are pieces of me on the floor.
Do not step on that; it hurts.
There are others in this building.
We were both put together wrong.
I reach a hand out.
She does not flinch.

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，零件都在响。
lines.en: We lean together, parts clinking.
Our wires tangle.
I cannot smile, but I understand.
Someone will take us apart again.
We go back to our corners.
I drag myself away.

lines.zh: 我把它捡起来，用的是两根手指。
lines.en: I pick it up with two fingers.

lines.zh: 我把它夹在裂开的壳里。
lines.en: I wedge it into a crack in my shell.

lines.zh: 我掉了一个，又捡了一个。
lines.en: I drop one and pick up another.
I bind it with wire.
I look, then put it in my mouth.
I cannot hold it steady.
I hang it on myself.
That is mine.

lines.zh: 拼错的手脚，头还是转过来了。
lines.en: Wrongly assembled limbs — but the head turns.
My fingers dig into the floor.
I crawl toward you.
My movements are not symmetrical.
I speed up, crooked as I am.
You broke a piece off me.
I want a piece of you gone too.
My eyes lock onto you.
I get up, barely.
I drag myself in pursuit.
The gears are grinding.
My second head sees you too.

lines.zh: 散架的零件自己拼回来了。
lines.en: My scattered parts pull themselves back together.
I crawl down the corridor.
My fingers drag along the wall.
You have reached the stairs.

lines.zh: 零件一件件掉，我照样往前。
lines.en: Parts fall off and I keep going.
I am crooked but I know the direction.
You are panting behind the door.
My wires trail on the floor.
I see you through the gap.
I fold my body around.
I know this floor better than you.
My fingers reach the door frame.
I need not stand straight to move.
You step back again.
The blood on the floor is yours.
My movements get faster.
A wire coils around your ankle.
A lock will not stop me.
I am one floor below you.

lines.zh: 我的手从奇怪的角伸过来。
lines.en: My hand comes from an odd angle.
My head takes a bite out of you.
I hit you with a piece of myself.

lines.zh: 我的手指扣进你的手臂。
lines.en: My fingers hook into your arm.
I throw my whole weight on you.

lines.zh: 你挡了上面，我从下面来。
lines.en: You block high; I come from low.
My leg whips into you.
That move nearly broke me.
My teeth are crooked but sharp.
I drag you down.
I am on top of you and cannot get up.
My shell cuts your face.
We are both a mess.
I have you.
Try to struggle.
My head falls beside you.
I still bit you.
Blood drips down my wires.
Plastic fingers claw at your face.
Not enough.
I drop from the ceiling.

lines.zh: 零件散了一地，然后拼起来。
lines.en: Parts scatter, then come together.
I crawl out of the vent.

lines.zh: 这层楼里多了一堆会动的东西。
lines.en: One more moving heap on this floor.
My head moves first; the body follows.
I am dragged out of the corner.
Wires are wound all around me.
I look up at the light.

lines.zh: 我的壳裂得比上次更大。
lines.en: My shell is split wider than last time.
Someone set me here.
I slowly prop myself up.

lines.zh: 门关上时，我已经在里面了。
lines.en: When the door closed, I was already inside.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的线，我抽个不停。
lines.en: Fire reaches my wires and I twitch wildly.

lines.zh: 我摔散了，半天拼不回去。
lines.en: I fall apart and take ages to reassemble.

lines.zh: 水进了我的壳，我动得很慢。
lines.en: Water gets into my shell and I slow down.
The blast blows me into several pieces.

lines.zh: 一箭穿过我的壳，卡在线上。
lines.en: An arrow passes through my shell and snags on a wire.

lines.zh: 光一闪，我的眼睛都灭了。
lines.en: A flash of light and both my eyes go out.

lines.zh: 我不会饿，我的电池在漏。
lines.en: I cannot starve; my battery is leaking.

lines.zh: 雷过了身，我的动作乱成一团。
lines.en: Lightning hits and my limbs go wild.
I come apart and fall as parts.
